name: claude-md-drift-audit
tagline_zh: CLAUDE.md 悄悄过时了？删掉的文件还在文档里诈尸。用上周 git 历史揪出失效路径和幽灵依赖，只出清单。
tagline_en: CLAUDE.md drifting? It cites files you deleted last week. This skill cross-checks git history, flags dead paths &.
desc_en: Audit every CLAUDE.md in this project for drift against the last week of git history. Flags sections that reference deleted files, renamed paths, or removed dependencies. Read-only — returns a punch list, never edits.
why_zh: 同类工具只看语法，它偏要对照 git 历史——连重命名和删除都逃不过，且绝不越权改动。
why_en: Unlike linters, it diffs against real git history—catches renames and deletions, and stays strictly read-only.
